name: Steadfast Midstaff
description: Take a wide braced guard with the stave diagonal, qi running through the legs into the planted feet.

name: Gust Poleturn
description: Advance in a gliding step with the stave levelled, qi evenly distributed through hips and legs.

name: Transfixing Jabbing
description: Thrust the stave straight at the chest, qi gathering at the tip to drive through light guards.

name: Torrent Ironcap
description: Wheel the stave to sweep aside a strike, qi stiffening the wheeling shaft against the force.

name: Rowanbarrage
description: Rebound off a parry and strike again from the same line, the first blow's momentum feeding the second.

name: Perchgreave
description: Hook the opponent's weapon with the stave and drag it down, qi tightening the arms.

name: Interlocking Hour Staffspin
description: Strike head, flank and shin in one continuous flow of the stave, qi pulsing at each landing.

name: Splitting Quarterpoint
description: Drive the stave down in a full-body smash that can split a guarding weapon, qi packed into the shoulders.

name: Annealed Staffgrip
description: Rest the stave in a loose guard between exchanges, qi circulating evenly through the arms.

name: Iron Rollover
description: Rap the opponent's weapon hand to open an exchange, a quick pulse of qi through the tip.

name: Oakassault
description: Slip aside from a thrust and return with a thrust of the stave on the same line.

name: Chime Rapidspin
description: Beat the stave against the opponent's guard to break its angle, qi firming the arms for the impact.

name: Staffleap
description: Step forward in a chain of small slides while the stave holds the guard, qi pacing the footwork.

name: Equipoise Nodeknot
description: Catch a swing high and cut back across the opponent's wrist in one motion.

name: Tiered Rollover
description: Land three blows at different heights in staggered rhythm, qi pulsing at the moment of each hit.

name: Glint Jabbing
description: Spiral the stave into a thrust that bores past the guard, qi stiffening the shaft into a drill.

name: Granite Oakstaff
description: Plant in a firm stance with the stave horizontal, qi sinking into the legs to hold the position.

name: Staffthrash
description: Sweep the stave behind the body to rap an attacker at the back, qi flaring through the arms.

name: Silencing Midstaff
description: Thrust the stave into an attacker's chest to check their advance, qi stiffening the shaft.

name: Whipping Staffend
description: Shuffle sideways along the line while the stave holds attackers at bay, qi easing the balance.

name: Murk Ashwood
description: Rotate the stave in front of the body to deflect a flurry of strikes, qi firming the arms.

name: Wrecking Poleturn
description: Pivot on the lead foot and strike at the nearest attacker, qi hardening the swing.

name: Oakthrash
description: Strike an attacker on one side and then spin to strike another, qi moving the stave in a flowing circle.

name: Ponderous Staffsweep
description: Press forward with a rapid string of strikes to drive back the line of attackers, qi sustaining the pace.

name: Oakplating
description: Return to the anchored guard after each exchange, qi settling the stance and closing the line.

name: Ashcuirass
description: Hold the stave level in a guard suited to armoured foes, qi gathered in the arms to take heavy blows.

name: Ashtorment
description: Rap the stave against armour in a rapid series, qi running through the shaft to shake the wearer.

name: Needling Staffshoe
description: Strike at the knee joint where armour is thin, qi hardening the stave's end.

name: Rowansprint
description: Step lightly around a heavy opponent so the stave's reach outruns the armour's weight, qi in the legs.

name: Facet Quarterpoint
description: Thrust the stave into a gap in the armour at the elbow or neck, qi narrowing to a point at the tip.

name: Hoarfrost Staffgrip
description: Slide the stave through the opponent's elbow joint and lever the arm, qi locking the grip.

name: Rumble Ironcap
description: Strike the helm with a qi-charged blow whose shock carries through the metal to the skull.

name: Severing Staffsweep
description: Sweep the stave under an armoured foe's legs and tip them to the ground, qi driving the lift.

name: Aura Midstaff
description: Hold the stave in guard and extend qi in a thin field around the shaft, widening the protected zone.

name: Tempered Poleturn
description: Thrust the stave with qi wrapped about the tip, the field adding bite beyond the wood.

name: Aurastaff
description: Sweep the stave in an arc trailing a band of qi, extending the strike beyond the shaft's length.

name: Surging Staffshoe
description: Step with qi drawn through the body field so the movement carries the stave smoothly.

name: Nimbus Ironcap
description: Parry with the shaft while pressing the field out, pushing the opponent's weapon further aside.

name: Tearing Rollover
description: Strike with a trailing arc of qi that follows the stave's path and catches a dodging opponent.

name: Funneling Staffspin
description: Roll the stave through a series of strikes while the field follows, each motion refreshing the next.

name: Gyve Staffgrip
description: Press the stave and its field against the opponent's weapon and hold it fast, qi steadying the field.

name: Scorching Blaze Quarterpoint
description: Release the stored field in a single heavy smash, qi flaring outward from the stave on impact.

name: Adamant Oakstaff
description: Hold the stave in the paired guard, one hand running the guard track and the other held for the strike track.

name: Racing Poleturn
description: Advance with the swift glide of a hawk's stoop, qi carried evenly through the paired steps.

name: Lambasting Jabbing
description: Thrust along a straight line with the strike hand, the guard hand steadying the shaft, a pulse of qi at the tip.

name: Resilient Staffend
description: Turn aside a blow with both hands working together, the guard track absorbing and the strike track redirecting.

name: Successive Rollover
description: Pair each guard with a strike so every defence is answered at once, qi pulsing through both hands.

name: Perchassault
description: Sweep the stave in a wide basin-shaped arc low to the ground, qi hardening the shaft.

name: Shade Rapidspin
description: Deliver two raps with alternating ends of the stave in swift succession, qi sharpening the motion.

name: Mayhem Staffshoe
description: Swap guard and strike hands mid-exchange, qi flowing between them to wrong-foot the opponent.

name: Thornash
description: Stand with the stave curving across the body like a river's bend, qi flowing along the shaft.

name: Rowanthrash
description: Thrust along a curving line that bends around the opponent's guard, qi adjusting at the last moment.

name: Staffcanter
description: Step in a winding path across the opponent's front, the stave following the curve, qi smooth in the legs.

name: Torrent Nodeknot
description: Parry a blow and let it flow off along the shaft like water along a bank, qi holding the arms soft.

name: Furrowing Rollover
description: Swing the stave in a tight circling eddy that catches the opponent's weapon and turns it aside.

name: Compounding Staffspin
description: Curve the stave around a guard and strike at the exposed side, qi flowing smoothly through the move.

name: Rowanplating
description: Draw the stave and the opponent's weapon together at a point of contact and hold them, qi merging in the grip.

name: Sanguine Staffspin
description: Gather momentum along a curve and smash the stave down, qi surging through the shoulders on impact.

name: Immovable Ashwood
description: Return to a calm guard after a flurry, qi settling evenly across the stance like a pool.

name: Hardened Quarterpoint
description: Hold the stave high above the head like a hawk watching, qi spread in a field about the shaft.

name: Soaring Staffspin
description: Slide forward on a long smooth step, qi carrying the body low and fast beneath the stave.

name: Ravaging Jabbing
description: Dive the stave tip down from the high guard in a stoop at the opponent's chest, qi flaring at the tip.

name: Chime Oakstaff
description: Spread the hands wide on the shaft and sweep a blow aside like a wing, qi widening the field.

name: Rowantorment
description: Dive twice in a single descent, one strike at the head and one at the knee, qi flaring at each landing.

name: Manacling Staffgrip
description: Hook the end of the stave around the opponent's weapon like a talon and drag it down, qi gripping the wood.

name: Hour Rollover
description: Pursue a retreating opponent with a long diving strike in each of two tracks, qi quickening the steps.

name: Nova Quarterpoint
description: Strike upward from a low guard with a rising thrust under the opponent's chin, qi sharpening to a point.

name: Vaulting Balancegrip
description: Leap back to the high guard after the stoop, qi lifting the body clear of a counter.

name: Ironoak
description: Open in a formal guard with the stave and its qi field held as a pair, one covering high, one low.

name: Lancing Staffend
description: Thrust the stave while a second thread of qi runs parallel, two points striking at once.

name: Ironstaff
description: Sweep the stave and its field in a pair of low arcs, qi extending the sweep past the shaft's end.

name: Bounding Poleturn
description: Step in a matched pair of glides, the body and the qi field moving together around the opponent.

name: Staunch Nodeknot
description: Parry with the shaft and the field together, the pair absorbing and redirecting blows.

name: Intertwined Staffspin
description: Strike with the stave while the field follows a heartbeat behind, two blows from a single stroke.

name: Quelling Staffshoe
description: Press the stave and its field against the opponent's weapon from two sides and hold it fast, qi locking the grip.

name: Scorching Staffend
description: Drive the stave down in a heavy smash while a second charge of qi falls from the field above.

name: Unbroken Oakstaff
description: Close the exchange by returning stave and field to the paired guard, qi settling into the stance.

name: Enduring Ashwood
description: Take a bearing on the opponent and set the stave on that line, qi steadying the legs against the wind.

name: Perchjaunt
description: Walk forward with a wide steady step across open ground, qi carrying the stave level.

name: Oakbarrage
description: Thrust along the bearing with a rush of qi that follows the line to the tip.

name: Implacable Midstaff
description: Parry a blow from the side with the shaft angled like a sail, turning the force off the bearing.

name: Trouncing Poleturn
description: Swing the stave in a wide sweep like a gale along the plateau, qi hardening the shaft.

name: Funneling Rapidspin
description: Strike repeatedly along the same bearing without shifting, each blow carrying the next, qi pulsing at the tip.

name: Paralyzing Ironcap
description: Press the stave against the opponent's weapon and hold it still, the grip as steady as a sworn oath.

name: Might Staffsweep
description: Smash the stave down along the bearing in a blow that cleaves the air, qi packed into the arms.

name: Rowancloak
description: Hold a guard with no wall at the back, the stave turning to cover whichever side is open, qi steadying the legs.

name: Oakspurt
description: Glide across open ground in long low steps, keeping the stave levelled, qi flowing evenly through the body.

name: Gustash
description: Thrust along the bearing with the cutting speed of the wind, a thread of qi running to the tip.

name: Unshaken Quarterpoint
description: Turn aside a blow with the stave as a gale turns a banner, qi softening and stiffening the shaft as needed.

name: Rupturing Rapidspin
description: Circle round an opponent while striking at back and flank, qi quickening the legs and arms.

name: Crippling Nodeknot
description: Press the stave against the opponent's weapon and hold it still, qi making the grip unbreakable.

name: Alternating Staffend
description: Strike in a wheeling sequence that turns the open ground into the fighter's own ring, qi flowing through each blow.

name: Intent Staffsweep
description: Sweep the stave low in a wide arc that clears the ground in front, forcing the opponent back to the edge.

name: Immovable Quarterpoint
description: Return to the wide open guard after each exchange, qi steadying the stance like a rooted stone in the wind.

name: Hardened Staffgrip
description: Hold the stave loosely in guard and feel the wind and the opponent's motion, qi spreading in a field.

name: Ashpounce
description: Slide on the balls of the feet in the direction of the wind, qi lightening the body.

name: Glintoak
description: Strike at the instant the opponent's weapon turns, when its force is at its weakest, qi flaring at the tip.

name: Mantled Midstaff
description: Parry a blow and turn the stave to carry it off, as the wind carries a leaf, qi firming the arms.

name: Lancing Quarterpoint
description: Thrust along the held bearing, qi narrowing in a thread that pierces a guard.

name: Interlocking Rollover
description: Chain strikes in the pattern of an eddy, each one catching the opponent's recoil from the one before, qi pulsing at each landing.

name: Suppressing Nodeknot
description: Bind the opponent's weapon with the stave and hold it, qi making the hold as sure as a vow.

name: Splintering Staffspin
description: Smash the stave down wrapped in a gust of qi that explodes outward on impact.

name: Perchcloak
description: Recover to the guard and scatter the qi field outward, forcing the opponent back a step.

name: Annealed Midstaff
description: Wait in a low guard with the stave still, the whole body listening, qi coiled and spread through the legs.

name: Careening Staffend
description: Rush forward with the force of a gale, qi hurling the body across the ground while the stave stays level.

name: Needling Rapidspin
description: Open the assault with a thrust that carries a rushing line of qi through the tip.

name: Gust Oakstaff
description: Parry a counter-blow and turn the stave on, qi turning the wood like a vane.

name: Blazeoak
description: Strike along a bearing the opponent cannot step off, qi following the line.

name: Staffcloak
description: Seize the opponent's weapon with the stave and hold it as an oath is held, qi locking the grip against any pull.

name: Compounding Poleturn
description: Unleash an unbroken storm of strikes in all directions, each carrying qi, and refuse to pause until the guard fails.

name: Unmaking Iron Staffsweep
description: Finish with a plunging smash that splits the opponent's guard, qi bursting at the point of impact.

name: Staunch Ironcap
description: End in a still guard once the storm has passed, qi sinking back into the legs and the stave held at rest.
